# Pete Guzzo

Pete Guzzo is an Executive Producer + Operations Strategist based in Tampa, FL. He's the person companies bring in when content, production, marketing, operations, studios, and business strategy are all tangled together and someone needs to make it work.

## Background
20+ years in branded content, film, and TV. MBA in Marketing & Project Management and BS in Film & Visual Communications, both from the University of Tampa. Career history: Shear Enterprises Inc. (Shear Media Studios, 2024–present), Kestum Bilt (founder, 2015–2024), HSN/Qurate (2013–present), Tampa Digital Studios (2006–2013). Also operates independently under the banner PG2.

## Studios
Pete designs and operates studio systems, not just rooms. Shear Media Studios (Tampa/St. Petersburg, FL) is an 11,000 sq. ft. multi-studio facility he designed and runs, built for podcast/media production, live shopping, commercial/photography production, and corporate multi-stream events. 211 Studio is a converted office building turned creative production hub he developed in Tampa, FL.
